artifact_observations.reasoning: The engraving on the square charm attempts to mimic complex characters (possibly Chinese seal script) but resolves into nonsensical, melted geometric shapes rather than legible strokes. This is a common AI artifact when rendering text/symbols.

artifact_observations.location: Jump rings connecting charms to chain
artifact_observations.reasoning: The connection points (jump rings) between some charms and the main chain appear slightly fused or indistinct, lacking the clear physical separation expected in macro photography of jewelry.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of jewelry and material composition (silver/metal vs. other).
To analyze the realism of the specular highlights and the clarity of the engraved details on the charms.
To verify that the interlocking links are topologically correct (linked through each other) and not just visually overlapping or fused.

focus_areas: Integrity of chain links (interlocking vs. fusion)
Legibility and structure of engraved symbols on charms
Realism of metallic reflections and shadows
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact on the charms. AI often fails to render coherent characters on small surfaces. Also, verify if the chain links are physically interlocked or if they are merely touching/fused, which is a subtle structural failure in AI jewelry generation.
